subject: GI ideas: reduce answer collisions, reinforce W2.b
body:
Three product ideas to keep Kai on track and reduce answer collisions:

1. W2.b micro-drill generator: small 5-question drill that only covers intercepts for sqrt, abs, quadratic vertex, exponential. Could be a lightweight JSON template with random coefficients to avoid duplicate answers.

2. Cross-exam uniqueness gate: run tests/cross-exam-verify.js on any data/*.json change and show warnings in CI or pre-commit. This avoids duplicate answer patterns before they ship.

3. Dashboard readiness checklist: small card that says "Practice-6 then Practice-7" with a checkbox and last score, so Kai sees the exact path to Grade 4.

If you want, I can help spec any of these.
